Naveed Ul Islam

President & CEO — nTrust.ai

Naveed Ul Islam is the founder and President of nTrust.ai, a for-profit cybersecurity startup architected to deliver more than $500,000 in annual net profit through elite AI security strategy, architectural hardening, and automated compliance engineering.

With a Master's Degree in Cybersecurity from UC Berkeley and an Applied Data Science/AI Diploma from UC Berkeley, Naveed combines deep technical rigor with commercial execution. He leads nTrust's mission to replace human-led consulting with durable, automated expert systems — bridging NIST AI RMF compliance, EU AI Act readiness, and real-world threat intelligence into market-ready products.

Under his leadership, nTrust has built the TrustGuard, PrivacyGuard, and TrustAudit MVP pipelines, establishing a scalable SaaS architecture designed for rapid enterprise adoption and high-margin recurring revenue.
